_readme: Roots for the DAILY OPTIONS -> PARQUET -> GOOGLE DRIVE job ONLY. Deliberately separate from index.json / equity.json / derivatives-config.json so the existing expiry archive (archive/parquetExport.js) and spot prune (spot/pruneOldSpot.js) never read it. Phase 1 = NIFTY only; more roots are added here after sir approves the CSV. 'cycles' = which expiry cycles to store (NIFTY and SENSEX have weekly+monthly; BANKNIFTY, FINNIFTY and stocks are monthly only - see derivatives-config.json). 'atmWidth' = strikes each side of ATM (2 = ATM, 2 above, 2 below). Spot/lookup symbols are NOT repeated here: they come from index.json via findCuratedEntry().
